mapper.sql: i.id, i.type, i.name, i.parent_id, i.size, i.content_type, i.inline_viewable, u.name AS uploader_name, coalesce(u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL, FALSE) AS uploader_withdrawn, i.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM drive_item i LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = i.uploader_id WHERE i.id = #{itemId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL

WITH RECURSIVE up AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, p.parent_id, 1 AS level FROM drive_item p WHERE p.id = (SELECT parent_id FROM drive_item WHERE id = #{itemId}) UNION ALL SELECT p.id, p.name, p.parent_id, up.level + 1 FROM drive_item p JOIN up ON p.id = up.parent_id) SELECT id, name FROM up ORDER BY level DESC

SELECT t.id, t.type, t.name, coalesce(path.original_path, '/') AS original_path, t.trashed_at FROM drive_item t LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( WITH RECURSIVE up AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, CASE WHEN p.trashed_at IS NULL THEN p.parent_id ELSE p.original_parent_id END AS next_id, 1 AS level FROM drive_item p WHERE p.id = t.original_parent_id UNION ALL SELECT p.id, p.name, CASE WHEN p.trashed_at IS NULL THEN p.parent_id ELSE p.original_parent_id END, up.level + 1 FROM drive_item p JOIN up ON p.id = up.next_id WHERE up.level < 20) SELECT '/' || string_agg(name, '/' ORDER BY level DESC) AS original_path FROM up ) path ON TRUE WHERE t.space_id = #{spaceId} AND t.trashed_at IS NOT NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.trashed_at DESC, t.id DESC
